subject: Summit Health — Concierge onboarding plan and kickoff ownership
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@summithealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@summithealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Summit Health — Concierge onboarding plan and kickoff ownership

Hi Jenna / Carlos —

Great to be across the finish line. Attached is the final SOW (v3) and the commercial PO template (we can accept a signed PDF). High level: 12-month Dedicated plan, 2 dedicated GPU nodes, 99.9% uptime SLA, and a phased rollout across three clinical teams.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm the PO (or attach your PO) and any procurement contacts we should loop in.
- Technical kickoff: propose Mon 2027-05-24 or Tue 2027-05-25, 10–11am PT. We’ll run a 60-minute session (introductions, success criteria, SSO/SCIM review, network/firewall items, rollout cadence).
- Pre-kickoff asks for Summit team: SSO contact, network IPs to whitelist, any regulatory constraints for PHI in staging.

Internal note for CS: I’m assigning the implementation to the CS team — see internal follow-up. Expecting go-live pilot with Team A in ~6 weeks assuming no compliance blockers.

Attachments: Summit_Health_SOW_v3.pdf

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@summithealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@summithealth.com>, procurement@summithealth.com
Date: 2027-05-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit Health — Concierge onboarding plan and kickoff ownership

Alex —

Thanks, and congrats on getting this across the line. We’ve attached the signed PO (PO #45321) and a preliminary network whitelist spreadsheet from our infra team. Carlos (cc’d) will be our technical lead for the kickoff; he can coordinate on firewall and VPC peering.

Availability for kickoff: Mon 5/24 10–11am PT works for Carlos and me. Procurement copied for contract/PO confirmation.

One note: our compliance lead requested the data retention default be 90 days in staging; we may ask to extend to 180 if pilot proves clean.

Attachments: Summit_Health_PO_45321.pdf, Network_Whitelist_Template.xlsx

Best,
Jenna Park
Director of Digital Clinical Ops
Summit Health
jenna.park@summithealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Summit Health — Sales->CS context and risks

Team —

Context (short): Summit Health signed a 12-month Dedicated contract (deal SUM-202705-45321). Key commercials: committed monthly capacity 2 GPU nodes, initial pilot scope = clinical triage model ingestion for 3 clinics. Revenue recognized immediately per PO.

Goals for CS/Implementation:
- Kickoff Mon 5/24 10am PT (confirmed) — 60 min.
- Deliverables before kickoff: access to SSO (Okta metadata), network IPs to whitelist, signed PO (attached by Alex).
- 6-week pilot to production-ready for Team A.

Risks / Open items:
- Compliance: customer prefers 90-day retention in staging; compliance may ask for 180d. Need to check with security if we can make retention configurable per environment quickly.
- Network: Carlos will request VPC peering or whitelisting; Vivek, please confirm which set of IPs we can provide and whether we need a VPN.
- Timeline sensitivity: they expect Team A live in ~6 weeks; delays on SSO or firewall access will push that.

Ownership recommendation:
- Primary CS Owner (customer-facing): karthik_iyer (please own kickoff and weekly check-ins)
- Implementation Lead (technical): laura_bennett (v. experienced with Dedicated deployments)
- Infra escalation & peering: vivek_kulkarni

Action items for today:
- Karthik: share pre-kickoff checklist and calendar invite with customer (include Laura + Vivek).
- Vivek: confirm whitelist IP range we can promise and any additional steps for VPC peering.
- Alex: confirm procurement contact and drop the signed PO into the shared Drive link.

-Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, alex.martinez@redwood.ai, jenna.park@summithealth.com, c.mendez@summithealth.com
Date: 2027-05-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Summit Health — Sales->CS context and risks

Thanks Marissa / Alex — I’ll take lead. Laura, Vivek — I’ll send the kickoff invite for Mon 5/24 10–11am PT and include a pre-kickoff checklist.

Pre-kickoff checklist (I’ll attach as a short doc to the invite):
- Okta metadata or SAML endpoints + test account (SSO)
- Network whitelist spreadsheet (customer provided — good)
- Contact info for compliance lead and data protection officer
- Test data sample (anonymized) for model validation
- Confirm staging retention policy and whether we should pre-config to 90d or leave as default 30d pending compliance review

I’ll also update HubSpot to "Implementation - Kickoff Scheduled" and link the drive docs. Laura — can you scope out a 6-week milestone plan after the kickoff (week-by-week deliverables + owners)? Vivek — can you confirm whether peering is required or if IP whitelisting suffices for initial pilot? If peering is required, estimate lead time.

Karthik
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@summithealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@summithealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, procurement@summithealth.com
Date: 2027-05-20T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit Health — Concierge onboarding plan and kickoff ownership

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirmed: kickoff Mon 5/24 10–11am PT. Karthik will lead the session; Laura and Vivek will join for the technical deep-dive. Jenna / Carlos — we received PO #45321 (thank you). I’ve placed the signed PO and the SOW in the shared drive (link above).

Notes for kickoff: please be prepared to: share SSO metadata, confirm whitelist rows in the spreadsheet, and introduce your compliance lead for a 10–15m compliance sync during the call. If any procurement paperwork still outstanding, procurement@summithealth.com is cc’d.

Attachments (for record): Summit_Health_SOW_v3.pdf, Summit_Health_PO_45321.pdf, Network_Whitelist_Template.xlsx

Looking forward —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
